MARTIN: 	Before you go on, get some sounds of those rats for me will ya? 
DAVID: 	Sure... Ah jeez, they're big suckers. Wonder what they're eating around here.
[SFX: DAVID WALKS OVER CLOSER TO THE RATS IN THE CORNER OF THE ROOM. AS WE GET CLOSER WE HEAR THEIR SQUEAKS, UNTIL THEY NOTICE HIM APPROACHING AND SCUTTLE AWAY.]
DAVID: 	They don't like visitors, I guess...
